FOLIAGE_AND_GAPS.finding: Smaller detailed leaves improve scale; separated radial rosettes and long bare branches leave crown volume incomplete. Side view exposes very long bare limbs; distant clearing trees retain separated leaf masses.

BARK_AND_JOINS.finding: Subtle bark bands improve surface variation; trunks remain smooth tapered columns and forks join abruptly without visible collars.

LIGHTING_AND_SHADOWS.finding: No clearly readable ground cast shadow in walking capture; foliage still appears comparatively flat. Static shadow resource execution is separately observed.

GRASS_AND_UNDERSTORY.finding: Varied local ground plants are visible; foreground remains mostly bare with small sparse blades. Distant view confirms reduced clearing ground density relative to the baseline.

SOIL_AND_ROCKS.finding: Added rocks are visible but read as pale angular mounds on a broad flat soil field.

ATMOSPHERIC_DEPTH.finding: Distant reviewed view shows flat green tree silhouettes without a clearly stronger depth gradient; the boundary of upgraded and unchanged trees remains visually conspicuous.
